notes: 0x79F000-0x7A4640 is PC-only UI code (uPauseMenu, uPausePractice, uPcBenchCock, uPcMessage, uPcSettings): no uPl SE identity, left unnamed. The DX9 uPlayer TU starts with uPlacement (0x7A4640) and then the SE TU-head automatic-battle code (0x7A4C00-0x7A5520), as at SE 0x99d9a0. Newly defined functions: 0x7A4650, 0x7A4700, 0x7A5920, 0x7A59B0, 0x7A5A00, 0x7A5A50, 0x7A5A80, 0x7A5AB0, 0x7A5AE0, 0x7A6640 (MyDTI::newInstance stubs and deleting dtors). Wrong existing names fixed (old kept as was:): registerWithMediator->setGameSystem, map_pad_btn_to_action->getInterfaceBtnInfo, uPlayerNero::setGunPoseLower/Hold->uPlayer::setActionPoseUpperBdy/LowerBdy (base uPlayer code, not Nero), uPlayerNero::setGunShotMotion_0/checkGunAutoShot->uPlayer::initShotAutoRepeat/checkShotAutoRepeat, uPlayerDante::addODGauge->uPlayer::addDevilTrgGuage, updateContactInfo->updateCharTbl, calcSpeedXZCapped->calcJumpRateLimit, checkAtckFlag->checkAtckBit, setAtckAction->setActionAtck, cWeaponCtrl::getWeapon->getLongWeapon, uPlCmnShl000::ctor_w (0x7AEFB0)->uPlayer::createCmnShl000. For P2/P6: 0x7B1010 (outside P1) is labelled uPlayer::updateLegLandEfct but is a cWeaponCtrl per-weapon update loop called from moveEx (likely uPlayer::cWeaponCtrl::updateEx); the real updateLegLandEfct is 0x7ABA20, named uPlayer::updateLegLandEfct_2 because of the collision. The callee of slot-90 afterPowerUp (0x7AF510) that is currently labelled uPlayer::afterPowerUp is not afterPowerUp: SE afterPowerUp calls initCommandCheck. Several SE virtuals are non-virtual in DX9 (setActionLand, setPoseWeapon, setPoseMotion, updateContactInfoSub, checkAtckBit, setVibJointCnst, getShotAutoChargeApproveLevel, initAutomaticCombo). SE beginDemo/endDemo/dispDebug* have no DX9 counterpart. Getter 0x7A56B0 (return -1) fills 7 uPlayer slots (86,125-130) = SE getUpperBdyVibJoint in all corresponding slots.
